stem: Trihalomethanes are organic molecules in which three of the hydrogen atoms of methane are replaced by halogen atoms, for example $\text{CHCl}_3$.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: $\text{CHCl}_3$ is a colourless liquid with a high vapour pressure.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Explain what is meant by high vapour pressure.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text:
An important reaction of $\text{CHCl}_3\text{(g)}$ is the manufacture of $\text{CHClF}_2\text{(g)}$, using the following reversible reaction.

$$\text{CHCl}_3\text{(g)} + 2\text{HF}\text{(g)} \rightleftharpoons \text{CHClF}_2\text{(g)} + 2\text{HCl}\text{(g)}$$

Use the data to calculate the enthalpy change of reaction, $\Delta H_{\text{r}}$, for the formation of $\text{CHClF}_2\text{(g)}$ as shown in the equation.

| compound | enthalpy change of formation, $\Delta H_{\text{f}}/\text{kJ mol}^{-1}$ |
| :--- | :--- |
| $\text{CHCl}_3\text{(g)}$ | -103.2 |
| $\text{CHClF}_2\text{(g)}$ | -482.2 |
| $\text{HF}\text{(g)}$ | -273.3 |
| $\text{HCl}\text{(g)}$ | -92.3 |

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text:
The reaction in (ii) is carried out using a heterogeneous catalyst.

Explain fully the meaning of the terms heterogeneous and catalyst.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: $\text{CHClF}_2$ was used as an alternative to chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs). $\text{CHClF}_2$ should no longer be used because it was found to contribute to the enhanced greenhouse effect.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Give the meaning of the term enhanced greenhouse effect.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Explain how $\text{CHClF}_2\text{(g)}$ may contribute to this effect.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Suggest another environmental problem associated with the use of $\text{CHClF}_2$.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
$\text{CHClF}_2$ is also used to produce the monomer tetrafluoroethene, $\text{C}_2\text{F}_4$.

This monomer can be used to produce poly(tetrafluoroethene), PTFE.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: State the type of polymerisation that occurs during the production of PTFE.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Draw the repeat unit of PTFE.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: Suggest why PTFE is used as a coating for cooking pans.

parts.label: (c)(iv)
parts.text:
Waste disposal can cause litter problems.

State two other difficulties associated with the disposal of PTFE.
